heat_pump.notes: ArenaEV lists the GT 63 (2026-) with Heat pump: Yes; 106 kWh usable. The Mercedes media page for the GT 4-Door (opened) does not mention a heat pump. ArenaEV is a spec database with EU figures; "Yes" does not say standard or optional and no Mercedes US/CA page could be opened (media.mbusa.com 404; KBB, Cars.com, Green Car Reports silent). ArenaEV lists "Heat pump: Yes" without saying standard or optional (it also says Yes for the 2019–21 i3, where it was a paid option), and its pages mix EU data.
